Page.Name: page.custom.notify
Page.Title: macOS notifications
Page.Subtitle: Banners of the Notification Center, sent with UNUserNotificationCenter (src/native_macos.m). The first one makes macOS ask for permission. They need an application bundle: the app is built as build/raven_app.app for that. When macOS refuses, the app falls back on AppleScript (shown as coming from Script Editor).

Demo.Title: The Dock
Demo.Note: NSDockTile: a badge on the icon; requestUserAttention bounces it while the app is not in front.
